svg.title: Reading the results
svg.desc: - Umbra is usable without the skill in the prompt: opus-bare passed everything with only umbra help in the task prompt, which suggests the CLI's help text holds up for agents (the installed skill was within their reach too, and their transcripts weren't kept to show whether they used it). The skill's value is efficiency and discipline: about 10× fewer help lookups, and none of opus-skill's runs fell back to sleep.
